0.label: left_rim_crowd_scene
0.description: The whole left side of the rim: a seated figure beside a pedestal bowl, kneeling figures, a large man raising a studded club or string of palm nuts, and tumbling or prostrate bodies toward the corner.
0.iconography: A dense scene rather than one motif: offering (the bowl), force or festivity (the raised club), and bodies falling or dancing. It may show a festival, a sacrifice, or the aftermath of a fight.

1.label: head_face_bared_teeth
1.description: A large face at the top centre of the rim, far bigger than any other figure: heavy lidded eyes, broad nose and a mouth showing a row of teeth.
1.iconography: The ojú ọpọ́n face of Ẹ̀ṣù. Bared teeth give it a fierce, commanding look over the crowd around the tray.

panel.title: Pillow-shaped Modakeke Ifá tray: a great face over a crowded world
panel.object_type: opon Ifá, rectangular with concave sides
panel.summary: A cushion-shaped tray with a small plain centre and a very wide rim packed with figures: a toothed face at the top, drummers and seated figures on the right, a club-bearer and tumbling bodies on the left, and a figure holding a cross-marked disc along the bottom.

register_readings.reading: The head: a great face with bared teeth.
Left side: offering bowl, kneeling figures, a raised club and falling bodies.
Right side (undetected): seated drummers with cylindrical drums, a figure with a staff.
Foot (undetected): a kneeling figure holding a round cross-marked disc (fan, mirror or shield), a leaning figure and more tumbling bodies.

panel.composition: One enormous face against dozens of small, busy figures that crowd every side and overlap; scale alone ranks the face above everyone.
panel.narrative: The most populous tray in the collection turns the rim into a whole community in motion — drumming, offering, carrying, falling — under Ẹ̀ṣù's gaze. It may record a festival (drums, the round fan) or a scene of violence (clubs, fallen bodies); either way, the world the diviner speaks to is crowded and lively, not an inventory.
panel.hypotheses: Some support for a narrative reading (actions, not just emblems), but no sequence of rulers. Not numerical.
cross_panel_links: Toothed face: compare the ilà-marked faces on FoA_04-5580 and FoA_04-5586.
Drummers and a round fan: KBA_10299 (drawn tray with a crowded border).
uncertainties: Only two boxes on a rim with dozens of figures; the reading is mostly from the photograph.
Tumbling figures could be acrobatic dancers or the dead.
